title: Top-Level Domains export
description: Machine-readable export of Top-Level Domains in the Domain Name System

generated.description: When this file was produced, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC.

source.description: The interactive presentation of this data.

schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema this file conforms to.

specversion.description: Version of this document format. Additions (new keys, new annotation keys) may appear without a version change and consumers should ignore keys they do not recognize; the version is incremented only for changes that break existing consumers.

domains.description: All records, sorted by name in ascending ASCII order. Names are unique.

date.description: A calendar date in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD form.

eventDate.description: An ISO 8601 date at the precision to which it is recorded: YYYY-MM-DD normally; YYYY-MM or YYYY only for early events that have no precise record.

hostname.description: A host name in lower-case ASCII without a trailing dot.

address.description: A postal address as supplied by the contact or manager. Each field is given where recorded.

address_lines.description: Ordered free-text address lines preceding the locality, as supplied: a street address, post office box, building, care-of or other delivery line.

state.description: State, province or other subnational region, where recorded.

country.description: Country or territory name as recorded, normally the ISO 3166-1 English short name.

country_iso.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for the country, where recorded.

manager.description: The organization responsible for managing the TLD.

last_updated.description: Date this manager record was last changed, where recorded.

contact.description: A point of contact for the TLD.

phone.description: Telephone number as supplied by the contact.

fax.description: Fax number as supplied by the contact.

last_updated.description: Date this contact record was last changed, where recorded.

dsRecord.description: A DS record published in the root zone for this TLD (RFC 4034 section 5).

algorithm.description: DNSSEC algorithm number from the IANA DNS Security Algorithm Numbers registry.

digest_type.description: Digest type from the IANA DS-RR Digest Types registry.

nameserver.description: An authoritative name server delegated in the root zone, with any glue addresses.

name.description: The TLD label in lower-case ASCII, following LDH rules (letters, digits and hyphens; no leading or trailing hyphen; at most 63 octets). For an internationalized domain name (IDN) this is the A-label (xn--...).

ulabel.description: The U-label (Unicode form) of an IDN TLD. Present for IDNs.

status.description: 'active': delegated in the root zone. 'retired': formerly delegated and now removed from the root zone. 'eligible': a string that is eligible for delegation but is not currently delegated (it may have been delegated in the past). 'reserved': not delegated and not available for delegation.

type.description: 'generic': gTLD. 'country-code': ccTLD, including IDN ccTLDs. 'special-use': names with a special technical purpose that are not available for general delegation, such as .arpa, .example and .onion. 'test': the IDN test TLDs delegated in 2007 and since retired.

script_code.description: Four-letter script subtag for the script of the label, from the IANA Language Subtag Registry.

iso3166_code.description: For an IDN ccTLD, the upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the corresponding country or territory.

annotations.description: Supplementary metadata. Each key is present only when a value is recorded.

delegation_round.description: The application round under which the TLD was delegated: 'pre-icann' for delegations before ICANN's application rounds, otherwise the year the round opened.

language_code.description: The language of the label as a BCP 47 language tag.

transliteration.description: A romanization of the label. No particular transliteration scheme is implied.

translation.description: The meaning of the label in English.

manager.description: The organization responsible for managing the TLD, where recorded.

contacts.description: Points of contact for the TLD, where recorded.

nameservers.description: Name servers delegated in the root zone. Empty when the TLD is not delegated.

ds_records.description: DS records in the root zone. Empty when the TLD is not delegated or not signed.

rdap_base_urls.description: RDAP base URLs. Empty when none are recorded. RDAP clients should use the IANA RDAP bootstrap registry for DNS (https://data.iana.org/rdap/dns.json).

items.description: An RDAP base URL, ending in '/'.

whois_server.description: WHOIS (port 43) server host name, where recorded.

registration_url.description: Web site for registration services as supplied by the manager, where recorded.

purpose.description: One-sentence summary of why the TLD is reserved or set aside for a particular use. Always present for a reserved TLD.

remarks.description: Explanatory text of any unique considerations for the TLD, in Markdown.

delegation.description: When the TLD was delegated in the root zone, where recorded. May be a year or year-month where the exact date is not known.

revocation.description: When a revoked TLD was removed from the root zone. May be a year or year-month where the exact date is not known.

last_updated.description: Date the record for this TLD was last changed, where recorded.
